baselinePolicy: Same candidate/App/fixture/assets. Restore ONLY exact Customize background stylesheet to4591. Shared base CSS imports are expanded from pinned Git blobs identically in both modes so nested filesystem imports cannot bypass the baseline. No header, character, layout or content substitution.
qualification: Actual default router/Auth/Phaser; QA06 DEV synthetic HTTP/C05/local admission only. Guarded Wall remains guarded; no live service or physical device acceptance.
